subject: Induction & exit controls evidence request for Sigilabs
messages:
From: Tyler Monroe <tyler.monroe@sigilabs.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@sigilabs.com, legal@sigilabs.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — induction & exit controls for Sigilabs

Diego,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we need a compact evidence set that demonstrates Redwood's employee onboarding and offboarding controls for the team that will handle Sigilabs data (inference serving + feature dev). Specifically we are looking for: 
- A mapping of identity verification steps (what checks you run) and the vendor used.
- Proof of training completion for security & data handling for a recent cohort (redacted is fine).
- Deprovisioning runbook and an example deprovisioning record.
- A short summary of your role-based access review cadence and where it is documented.

Can you confirm scope: do we get the full company artifacts or only the Inference/Model Serving group? Our compliance team prefers limited-scope packets.

Timeline: we need the packet within 10 business days if possible. If you need us to narrow the request, let us know.

Thanks — Tyler
Tyler Monroe
Senior Security Manager | Sigilabs
[Attachment: sig-request-form.pdf (customer intake form)]

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Tyler Monroe <tyler.monroe@sigilabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — induction & exit controls for Sigilabs

Tyler —

Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver a scoped packet for the Inference & Serving org (that contains the team handling Sigilabs workloads) which should satisfy SIG/CAIQ. Outline of what I'll package and owners: 

- Identity verification matrix (ID checks, vendor, retention) — owner: Olga Petrov.
  [Attachment: id-verification-matrix.csv (summary table)]
- Training completion samples — owner: Lauren Bishop (we'll provide redacted artifacts).
  [Attachment: training-completion-redacted.zip (redacted PDFs and a CSV index)]
- Deprovisioning runbook + a sanitized example log — owner: Diego Fernandez.
  [Attachment: deprovisioning-runbook.pdf (runbook), Attachment: onboarding-index.csv (sanitized index of onboarding records)]
- Role review cadence summary — short memo in the packet, plus links to our internal runbook.

Two quick questions for scope: 
1) Do you want vendor PII showing in samples, or should we fully redact vendor-supplied IDs? We'll redact employee-identifying fields by default and include unredacted templates if you need them under an executed NDA.
2) Do you need copies of vendor contracts (background-check vendor) or just the vendor name+service description?

Expect a first-draft packet by EOD Friday (2026-04-17). If that meets your timeline, we'll proceed.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0172

Attached is the scoped evidence packet for the Inference & Serving org. Summary of contents: 

1) id-verification-matrix.csv — outlines steps (gov ID match, automated SSN check, employment reference where applicable), vendor (CheckRight Inc.), retention policy (records retained 2 years post-hire).

2) onboarding-index.csv — sanitized index of a recent onboarding cohort (no PII).

3) training-completion-redacted.zip — contains redacted completion certificates (names replaced with cohort IDs) and a CSV export with course IDs, completion timestamps, and training version.

4) deprovisioning-runbook.pdf — our step-by-step playbook for access removal; included a sanitized example of an offboarding ticket and the audit entry.

Redaction notes: employee names and employee IDs are redacted; we kept timestamps, role tags, and ticket IDs intact. If Sigilabs requires unredacted originals for your SOC reviewer, we can provide them under an NDA and via a secure transfer.

Links for download (temporary access, 14-day expiry):
- https://drive.redwood.example.com/sigilabs-evidence/REQ-4532

If you want, we can add a short cover memo mapping each item back to SIG/CAIQ control IDs. Otherwise this packet should map cleanly to the onboarding/offboarding controls section.

Regards,
